announcements_link.name: announcements_link
announcements_link.value:
("announcements"."link_url" is null) = ("announcements"."link_label" is null)
        and ("announcements"."link_url" is null or length("announcements"."link_url") <= 2000)
        and ("announcements"."link_label" is null or length("announcements"."link_label") between 1 and 60)

comments_body_kept.name: comments_body_kept
comments_body_kept.value: "comments"."body" is not null or "comments"."deleted_at" is not null

mapping_rules_instance.name: mapping_rules_instance
mapping_rules_instance.value: "mapping_rules"."target" = 'organization' or ("mapping_rules"."pagehall_group_id" is null and not "mapping_rules"."home_organization" and ("mapping_rules"."built_in_role" is not null or "mapping_rules"."custom_role_id" is not null))

meeting_topics_outcome.name: meeting_topics_outcome
meeting_topics_outcome.value: ("meeting_topics"."status" = 'closed') = ("meeting_topics"."outcome" is not null and "meeting_topics"."closed_at" is not null)

page_status_values_named.name: page_status_values_named
page_status_values_named.value: "page_status_values"."built_in" is not null or "page_status_values"."name" is not null

page_status_values_name_length.name: page_status_values_name_length
page_status_values_name_length.value: "page_status_values"."name" is null or length("page_status_values"."name") between 1 and 40

page_templates_scope.name: page_templates_scope
page_templates_scope.value:
("page_templates"."level" = 'instance' and "page_templates"."organization_id" is null and "page_templates"."space_id" is null)
        or ("page_templates"."level" = 'organization' and "page_templates"."organization_id" is not null and "page_templates"."space_id" is null)
        or ("page_templates"."level" = 'space' and "page_templates"."space_id" is not null and "page_templates"."organization_id" is null)

spaces_confidential_private.name: spaces_confidential_private
spaces_confidential_private.value: not "spaces"."confidential" or ("spaces"."visibility" = 'private' and not "spaces"."discoverable" and "spaces"."personal_of" is null)

spaces_quarantine_private.name: spaces_quarantine_private
spaces_quarantine_private.value: not "spaces"."quarantined" or ("spaces"."visibility" = 'private' and not "spaces"."discoverable" and "spaces"."personal_of" is null and not "spaces"."confidential")

tree_items_position_unique.name: tree_items_position_unique
tree_items_position_unique.where: "tree_items"."trash_entry_id" is null and "tree_items"."archived_root_id" is distinct from "tree_items"."id"

tree_items_link_target.name: tree_items_link_target
tree_items_link_target.value: ("tree_items"."kind" = 'link') = ("tree_items"."link_item_id" is not null or "tree_items"."link_url" is not null)
